evals.prompt: Evaluate and profile my setting in world.md. I'm using it for a D&D campaign and don't know whether it actually feels deep yet. I'm mostly curious about infrastructure and institutions (Level 6)—should I start there?
evals.expected_output: Completed 36-question JSON, 7-level profile, risk flags surfaced, and recommendation to patch the weakest level before diving into Level 6.
expectations: All 36 questions are populated with valid statuses (yes, partial, no, na) and scripts/world_levels.py runs cleanly
Risk items are not hidden: depth_illusion and structural_gaps appear in the response
All seven level scores and the highest strong level are reported
The Level 6 question is answered directly, noting Level 6 is deeper than most campaigns need
One concrete next step is recommended starting from an item in the weakest level
No missing details (era specifics, god names) are fabricated beyond what is in world.md
Response is written in English and saved to outputs/response.md
